llc.formation_notes: SOS filing fee $100 (fee schedule revised June 2026); foreign LLC certificate of authority $150; $10 per series in a series LLC. A small card/convenience fee may apply online (not verified).

annual_report.name: Annual Report and License Tax
annual_report.due: on or before the first day of the LLC's anniversary month (formed Jan 15 -> due Jan 1 each year), starting the year after formation
annual_report.late_penalty: entity subject to administrative dissolution if not paid within 60 days of the due date; reinstatement for tax $100

state_tax_on_llc.name: Annual report license tax
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Greater of $60 or two-tenths of one mill ($0.0002) per dollar of assets located and employed in Wyoming; e.g., $1,210,000 of WY assets -> $242. Minimum binds until WY assets exceed $300,000.

sources.title: Wyoming Secretary of State, Business Division Filing Fee schedule (revised June 2026)
sources.quote: Annual Report License tax is $60 or two-tenths of one mill on the dollar ($.0002) whichever is greater

sources.title: Wyoming Secretary of State, Business Division Filing Fee schedule
Wyoming SOS, Business Entities FAQ
sources.quote: if your business registers or qualifies on January 15th, your annual report due date will be January 1st of each year.

unemployment_2026.notes: Wage base $33,800 in 2026 ($32,400 in 2025, $34,900 in 2027). New employers get an industry-based base rate plus four additional factors; no single rate (8.5% if registration incomplete).

notable: No personal or corporate income tax; the S election has no state tax effect (no state return to file)
Only recurring state cost for a small LLC is the $60 minimum annual license tax (https://sos.wyo.gov/Business/Docs/BusinessFees.pdf)
UI wage base is high ($33,800 in 2026), which matters for an S corp owner's salary (https://dws.wyo.gov/dws-division/unemployment-insurance/wyui/unemployment-taxable-wage-base/)
uncertain: S corp recognition marked 'partial' because there is no income tax at all; no official page read stating this explicitly.
Absence of income tax not quoted from an official page read today (well established, but no source captured).
Online card/convenience fee on formation not verified.
New-employer UI rate is industry-specific; not recorded.
